holders.finding: Official registry identifies the commune as a municipal authority. No producer relationship or parcel-specific tenancy found; legal rights alone are not a research link.

Opale is controlled by Olivier Leflaive Frères (139077 of 139079 shares in 2019). The 2006 schedule names AH150/151 and AI137/138, not current AH182. AH151 is now recorded to Pousse d’Or; historical ownership remains separate from current farming.

The official registry and four company filings identify the viticultural company Domaine Fontaine-Gagnard. Selected formation, contribution and capital filings give no qualifying AE133 schedule or parcel-specific current farming evidence.

The official registry and five company filings identify Domaine Heitz-Lochardet. The 2021 property contribution concerns other communes; the 2024 contribution transfers company shares to Faciens Vinum. No qualifying current AH16 schedule found.

Four selected filings concern formation, transformation, property contribution and merger; no qualifying AH151 schedule found. Existing reviewed Pousse d’Or link is reused unchanged. Opale’s 2006 AH151 ownership recital remains external historical context.

Five selected filings cover transformation, merger and 2026 reorganisation; no current Montrachet reference with individual area found. Existing reviewed Bouchard group link is reused without alteration; the 2026 contribution excludes vineyard property from the transferred business.

The GFA contribution names AE134 (821 m²). A 2011 deed recites its 2009 lease to Domaine Leflaive, ending 11 November 2033. The original lease and current performance are unreviewed; the separate Verzé lease is not Montrachet evidence.

H2O, formerly Moulin d’Eugénie, is controlled by Domaine d’Eugénie: the July 2026 statutes record 157899 of 188860 shares. Formation and contribution records do not give an exact AE172 schedule. Corporate control is not parcel tenancy or current farming.

The 1994 decision transfers the operating branch to SARL Domaine des Comtes Lafon and retains the land company as a GFA. The 1996 donation recites estate leases; no AE37 schedule or current renewal is established. Corporate succession is not farming.

The estate is distinct from its GFA: AE134 (821 m²) was withdrawn and contributed to the GFA in 2009. No qualifying current AH77 schedule found. The July resolution mandates a future lease; it is not an executed lease.

The 21 December 1974 notarial estate schedule names AE31 (3419 m²) and AE129 (1670 m²), matching current recorded DRC rights. AE130 is not printed in that schedule. The 2002 deposit is not a 2002 land transfer. Existing reviewed company link is reused unchanged.

Formation names retired AE27/28/161/162 (356/356/178/178 m²) and recites a 19 July 1996 lease to EARL Domaine Colin Marc et Fils. Current AE208–220 are reached only through official DFI ancestry; no current farming season established.

AH64 and its 20625 m² area establish the GFA de Laguiche identity. The 2002 donation names Jean de Laguiche personally as tenant. Drouhin’s published cultivation account does not establish a Drouhin company lease; current farming is unverified.

Three distinct selected files (31 pages) concern share succession and updated statutes, without AE32/34 and their individual areas. A company candidate exists, but the U21850980 identity crosswalk is not established by the reviewed company records; no domaine link asserted.

Company statutes repeat AE30 (2090 m²) and AE33 (3773 m²), plus Chevalier AH3/8. The current exact schedule and registry/official legal notice support U21874820 to SCEA Domaine Jacques Prieur (778233098). No parcel-specific farming season established.

externalResearch.title: Les Enfants Colin: retired references and historical lease
externalResearch.finding: The 19 August 2003 formation names retired AE27/28/161/162 with individual areas 356/356/178/178 m² and recites a 19 July 1996 lease to EARL Domaine Colin Marc et Fils. The original references reach AE208–220 only through official DFI document 210:150:000:0000558 (27 February 2023), retaining the complete event groups and partial scope. Neither rights nor a tenant are automatically transferred to the daughters. No original lease, renewal or present farming season was reviewed.
externalResearch.appNote: The 2003 GFA filing names this parcel’s retired predecessor and recites a 1996 lease to Domaine Colin Marc et Fils. Reached through official 2023 DFI lineage; no present tenancy or farming inferred.

Producer and company-filing investigations remain Tier 2. Paid SPF copies and outreach remain Tier 3.
Source boundaries, failed notice downloads and unsearched intervals are reported in the history coverage; none means no historical record.
Current farming remains unconfirmed for every parcel.
INPI and Pappers were each tried once on the Leflaive company and returned HTTP 403 locally; free official company searches, Le Figaro indexes and actes.ccm2.net filings were used instead.

The bounded Montrachet pass screened 50 distinct PDF byte hashes / 1360 pages at 150 dpi with RapidOCR and DirectML. Two additional downloads were byte-identical copies (34 duplicate pages), not additional evidence; one Leflaive 2026 statutes request returned HTTP 408. This is not every filing ever deposited.

No company-record identity crosswalk was established for U21850980 (Thenard). GFA de Laguiche identity is established, but its individual tenant is not converted to a Drouhin company link. The commune has no producer link.

Winehog subscriber copies were requested once. Direct article links were supplied on 9 October 2026; authorized copies remain pending. Unsupplied articles are access gaps, with no acquired-copy SHA-256 and no accepted parcel matches.

Exact filing coverage is limited to six current parcels: AE30/31/33/129/134 and AH64. Colin’s thirteen current references receive historical context only through DFI ancestry. No current farming season is verified.
